hook: Dry till *Dec 3*: nights to get 2-4°C colder
hook_b: Dry till *Dec 3*: nights to get 2-4°C colder
tldr: IMD Hyderabad predicts light to moderate rain over two days followed by dry weather, with misty mornings.

beats.what: Southern and central Telangana, including Hyderabad, could see isolated rain from November 25 to 27.
beats.why: IMD says partly cloudy skies and hazy morning conditions will persist due to the rain effect.
beats.care: Expect hazy early commutes now and colder nights from the weekend.

cards.title: 🆕 Evening update
cards.body: IMD Hyderabad says dry weather is very likely from Thursday morning till December 3, with minimum temperatures dropping 2-4°C over the next five days.

qs: How cold could nights get during the Nov 29-Dec 4 spell?

facts.t: IMD expects minimums to drop *2-4°C* over five days as dry weather returns.
IMD predicts light to moderate rain for *two days*, then dry weather.
Till 11 am Wednesday, *3.8 mm* rain fell in Kamkole (Sangareddy) and Gunegal (Rangareddy).

viz.verdict: Cooler nights ahead as clouds clear.

viz.l: Lowest minimum, 24 hrs to 8.30 am Thu
viz.verdict: Districts are far colder than the city for now.

watch: Whether city minimums dip below 18°C by the weekend.
